<documents>
<document id="card-replacement-basic">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆOnˆBasic,ˆifˆyouˆchooseˆexpeditedˆshippingˆyouˆpayˆbothˆtheˆreplacementˆfeeˆandˆtheˆshippingˆfee.ˆStandardˆshippingˆonlyˆcostsˆtheˆreplacementˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="security-account-takeover">
IfˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆelseˆhasˆsignedˆinˆtoˆyourˆaccount,ˆactˆfast.ˆ##ˆSignsˆtoˆlookˆforˆ-ˆAˆpasswordˆchangeˆorˆnew-deviceˆsign-inˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆ-ˆYourˆemailˆaddressˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆchangedˆwithoutˆyouˆ-ˆTransfersˆorˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆyouˆdidn'tˆsendˆ-ˆYou'reˆsuddenlyˆsignedˆoutˆandˆcan'tˆsignˆbackˆinˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆin,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆfreezeˆyourˆcards.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆcallˆusˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆ##ˆWhatˆwe'llˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆandˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆaccountˆtakeovers.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆusuallyˆmuchˆfaster.ˆTheyˆmayˆsignˆoutˆeveryˆdevice,ˆresetˆyourˆcredentialsˆandˆreviewˆrecentˆactivityˆwithˆyou.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆtransfersˆorˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆduringˆaˆtakeoverˆinvestigation.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆdoesˆthatˆonceˆthey'veˆconfirmedˆwhoˆyouˆare.ˆ##ˆAfterwardˆCheckˆyourˆemailˆaccount'sˆsecurityˆtoo.ˆManyˆtakeoversˆstartˆwithˆaˆcompromisedˆemail.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="plan-plus">
TheˆPlusˆplanˆPlusˆcostsˆ$5.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆIt'sˆbuiltˆforˆpeopleˆwhoˆuseˆtheirˆcardˆaˆlotˆawayˆfromˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆorˆspendˆsomeˆtimeˆabroad,ˆandˆitˆaddsˆCushionˆandˆaˆhigherˆsavingsˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs,ˆplusˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆaˆmonth.ˆAfterˆthatˆit'sˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,000ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPlusˆincludesˆoutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆforˆ$35.00ˆeach.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆplastic,ˆlikeˆBasic.ˆUpgradeˆtoˆPremiumˆifˆyouˆwantˆtheˆmetalˆcard.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the fee to replace my card on Basic, and how much more if I want it fast?
